newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Grand Hotel takes option on Melbourne Hyatt.
newsitem.headline: Grand Hotel takes option on Melbourne Hyatt.

text.p: Grand Hotel Group said on Wednesday it has agreed to procure an option to purchase the remaining 50 percent of the Grand Hyatt complex in Melbourne from hotel developer and investor Lustig & Moar.
The option could exercised up to the end of 1999, and the purchase price would be 50 percent of an independent valuation at June 30, 2000, it said.

Grand Hotel, which listed last August, said under the agreement it will immediately assume greater responsibility for liason with the hotel operator and management of the non-hotel components of the complex.

Grand Hotel said it had acquired the option by agreeing to the extension of an A$85 million letter of credit facility provided by Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd and State Bank of New South Wales Ltd, now Colonial Ltd, for a further two years to June 30, 2000.
Lustig & Moar would pay annual fees to the Grand Hotel Group for this facility, it said.
